commit 38dc4c8ee2ec605e571ffccdfaa800073d1635f2
Author:     Justin Tracey <jtracey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Sun Oct 26 16:23:59 2025 +0200
Commit:     Justin Tracey <jtracey@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Sun Oct 26 16:23:59 2025 +0200

    Bug 1989608: Add linux64 asan fuzzing target. r=coreyb
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D268606

diff --git a/mail/config/mozconfigs/linux64/nightly-fuzzing-asan b/mail/config/mozconfigs/linux64/nightly-fuzzing-asan
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..b94b95eb855
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mail/config/mozconfigs/linux64/nightly-fuzzing-asan
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/build/mozconfig.comm-sccache"
+. "$topsrcdir/comm/mail/config/mozconfigs/linux64/common-linux64"
+
+ac_add_options --enable-debug-symbols=-gline-tables-only
+
+# ASan specific options on Linux
+ac_add_options --enable-valgrind
+
+. "$topsrcdir/build/unix/mozconfig.asan"
+ac_add_options --disable-elf-hack
+
+# Piggybacking UBSan for now since only a small subset of checks are enabled.
+# A new build can be created when appropriate.
+ac_add_options --enable-undefined-sanitizer
+
+# Need this to prevent name conflicts with the normal nightly build packages
+export MOZ_PKG_SPECIAL=asan
+
+# Disable telemetry
+ac_add_options MOZ_TELEMETRY_REPORTING=
+
+ac_add_options --enable-fuzzing
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
index 7934bab43fb..22eb5534f1b 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
@@ -146,6 +146,42 @@ linux64-asan/opt:
             - linux64-sccache
             - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
 
+linux64-asan-fuzzing/opt:
+    description: "Linux64 Fuzzing Opt ASAN"
+    index:
+        product: thunderbird
+        job-name: linux64-fuzzing-asan-opt
+    attributes:
+        # The gtest libxul contains libFuzzer targets
+        skip-verify-test-packaging: true
+    treeherder:
+        platform: linux64/asan
+        symbol: Bof
+    worker:
+        env:
+            PERFHERDER_EXTRA_OPTIONS: asan-fuzzing
+            ASAN_OPTIONS: "detect_leaks=0"
+            MOZ_AUTOMATION_PACKAGE_TESTS: "1"
+        max-run-time: 5400
+    run:
+        config:
+            - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
+            - builds/releng_base_linux_64_builds.py
+        custom-build-variant-cfg: fuzzing-asan-tc
+        mozconfig-variant: nightly-fuzzing-asan
+        tooltool-downloads: public
+    run-on-projects: ['comm-central']
+    use-sccache: true
+    optimization:
+        skip-unless-backstop: null
+    fetches:
+        toolchain:
+            - linux64-libotr
+            - linux64-llvm-symbolizer
+            - linux64-rust-dev
+            - linux64-sccache
+            - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
+
 linux64-asan-reporter-shippable/opt:
     description: "Linux64 Opt ASAN Reporter (Shippable)"
     attributes:
title: Bug 1989608: Add linux64 asan fuzzing target. r=coreyb
